```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)

ICECBPdata <- read_csv("data/ICECBPdata.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = parse_date_time(
      Date,
      orders = c("mdy", "dmy", "ymd")
    ),
    Year = year(Date)
  )
```


```{r}
#| echo: false

# Create IDs for filtering
ICECBPdata <- ICECBPdata %>%
  mutate(
    state_id = as.integer(factor(State)),
    cause_id = as.integer(
      factor(`Cause of Death (Official)`)
    ),
    custody_id = as.integer(
      factor(Custody)
    )
  )

#filter options

year_options <- sort(
  unique(ICECBPdata$Year),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

state_options <- ICECBPdata %>%
  distinct(state_id, State) %>%
  filter(!is.na(State)) %>%
  arrange(State)

cause_options <- ICECBPdata %>%
  distinct(
    cause_id,
    `Cause of Death (Official)`
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`Cause of Death (Official)`)
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Cause of Death (Official)`)

custody_options <- ICECBPdata %>%
  distinct(custody_id, Custody) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Custody)) %>%
  arrange(Custody)

#filter controls
filter_panel <- tags$div(

  class = "d-flex align-items-end gap-2 mb-4 flex-wrap",

  # Year
  tags$div(
    style = "flex: 0 0 120px;",

    tags$label(
      `for` = "yearFilter",
      class = "form-label mb-1 small",
      tags$strong("Year")
    ),

    tags$select(
      id = "yearFilter",
      class = "form-select form-select-sm",

      tags$option(
        value = "all",
        "All Years"
      ),

      lapply(
        year_options,
        function(x) {
          tags$option(
            value = x,
            x
          )
        }
      )
    )
  ),


  #state
  tags$div(
    style = "flex: 0 0 160px;",

    tags$label(
      `for` = "stateFilter",
      class = "form-label mb-1 small",
      tags$strong("State")
    ),

    tags$select(
      id = "stateFilter",
      class = "form-select form-select-sm",

      tags$option(
        value = "all",
        "All States"
      ),

      lapply(
        seq_len(nrow(state_options)),
        function(x) {

          tags$option(
            value = state_options$state_id[x],
            state_options$State[x]
          )

        }
      )
    )
  ),


  #cause of death
  tags$div(
    style = "flex: 0 0 220px;",

    tags$label(
      `for` = "causeFilter",
      class = "form-label mb-1 small",
      tags$strong("Cause of Death")
    ),

    tags$select(
      id = "causeFilter",
      class = "form-select form-select-sm",

      tags$option(
        value = "all",
        "All Causes"
      ),

      lapply(
        seq_len(nrow(cause_options)),
        function(x) {

          tags$option(
            value = cause_options$cause_id[x],
            cause_options$`Cause of Death (Official)`[x]
          )

        }
      )
    )
  ),


  #custody
  tags$div(
    style = "flex: 0 0 150px;",

    tags$label(
      `for` = "custodyFilter",
      class = "form-label mb-1 small",
      tags$strong("DHS Custody")
    ),

    tags$select(
      id = "custodyFilter",
      class = "form-select form-select-sm",

      tags$option(
        value = "all",
        "All"
      ),

      lapply(
        seq_len(nrow(custody_options)),
        function(x) {

          tags$option(
            value = custody_options$custody_id[x],
            custody_options$Custody[x]
          )

        }
      )
    )
  ),


  #clear button
  tags$button(
    id = "clearFilters",
    class = "btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm",
    type = "button",
    style = "height: 31px;",
    "Clear Filters"
  ),

  # Result count
  tags$span(
    id = "resultCount",
    class = "text-muted small ms-2",
    style = "padding-bottom: 6px;"
  )
)

# Cards

cards <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(ICECBPdata)),
  function(i) {

    display_date <- format(
      ICECBPdata$Date[i],
      "%B %d, %Y"
    )


    tags$div(

      class = "card shadow-sm mb-4 source-card",

      `data-year` =
        ICECBPdata$Year[i],

      `data-state` =
        ICECBPdata$state_id[i],

      `data-cause` =
        ICECBPdata$cause_id[i],

      `data-custody` =
        ICECBPdata$custody_id[i],


      tags$div(

        class = "card-header",

        tags$h4(
          class = "mb-1",
          ICECBPdata$Name[i]
        ),

        tags$small(
          class = "text-muted",
          display_date
        )
      ),


      tags$div(

        class = "card-body",


        tags$p(

          tags$strong("Age:"),
          ICECBPdata$Age[i],

          tags$br(),

          tags$strong("Gender:"),
          ICECBPdata$Gender[i]
        ),


        tags$p(

          tags$strong("Location:"),
          tags$br(),

          ICECBPdata$Country[i],
          ", ",
          ICECBPdata$State[i],
          ", ",
          ICECBPdata$City[i]
        ),


        tags$p(

          tags$span(
            class = "badge bg-secondary",

            "In DHS Custody?: ",
            ICECBPdata$Custody[i]
          ),

          " ",

          tags$span(
            class = "badge bg-primary",

            "Cause of Death: ",
            ICECBPdata$`Cause of Death (Official)`[i]
          )
        ),


        tags$button(

          class = "btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm",

          type = "button",

          `data-bs-toggle` = "collapse",

          `data-bs-target` =
            paste0("#record", i),

          "View Full Record"
        ),


        tags$div(

          class = "collapse mt-4",

          id = paste0("record", i),


          tags$hr(),


          tags$h5(
            "Location of Death"
          ),

          tags$p(
            ICECBPdata$Country[i],
            ", ",
            ICECBPdata$State[i],
            ", ",
            ICECBPdata$City[i],
            ", ",
            ICECBPdata$County[i]
          ),


          tags$h5(
            "Coordinates"
          ),

          tags$p(
            "Latitude: ",
            ICECBPdata$Latitude[i],

            tags$br(),

            "Longitude: ",
            ICECBPdata$Longitude[i]
          ),


          tags$h5(
            "Cause of Death"
          ),

          tags$p(
            tags$strong("Official:"),
            tags$br(),
            ICECBPdata$`Cause of Death (Official)`[i]
          ),

          tags$p(
            tags$strong("Unofficial:"),
            tags$br(),
            ICECBPdata$`Cause of Death (Unofficial)`[i]
          ),


          tags$h5(
            "Facilities & Transfers"
          ),

          tags$p(
            ICECBPdata$`Facilities & Transfers`[i]
          ),


          tags$h5(
            "Other Notes"
          ),

          tags$p(
            ICECBPdata$`Other Notes`[i]
          ),


          tags$h5(
            "Sources"
          ),

          tags$p(

            tags$a(

              href =
                ICECBPdata$`Drive Link to Sources`[i],

              target = "_blank",

              "View Source Documents"
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  }
)

# Output

tagList(

  filter_panel,

  tags$div(
    id = "cardsContainer",
    cards
  )
)
```

## Add Javascript
```{html}
<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const cards =
    document.querySelectorAll(".source-card");

  const year =
    document.getElementById("yearFilter");

  const state =
    document.getElementById("stateFilter");

  const cause =
    document.getElementById("causeFilter");

  const custody =
    document.getElementById("custodyFilter");

  const clear =
    document.getElementById("clearFilters");

  const count =
    document.getElementById("resultCount");


  function filterCards() {

    let visible = 0;


    cards.forEach(function(card) {

      const yearMatch =
        year.value === "all" ||
        card.dataset.year === year.value;


      const stateMatch =
        state.value === "all" ||
        card.dataset.state === state.value;


      const causeMatch =
        cause.value === "all" ||
        card.dataset.cause === cause.value;


      const custodyMatch =
        custody.value === "all" ||
        card.dataset.custody === custody.value;


      const show =
        yearMatch &&
        stateMatch &&
        causeMatch &&
        custodyMatch;


      card.hidden = !show;


      if (show) {
        visible++;
      }

    });


    count.textContent =
      `Showing ${visible} of ${cards.length} records`;
  }


  year.addEventListener(
    "change",
    filterCards
  );

  state.addEventListener(
    "change",
    filterCards
  );

  cause.addEventListener(
    "change",
    filterCards
  );

  custody.addEventListener(
    "change",
    filterCards
  );


  clear.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function() {

      year.value = "all";
      state.value = "all";
      cause.value = "all";
      custody.value = "all";

      filterCards();
    }
  );


  filterCards();

});

</script>
```
